rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices used to set rents
rules.quote: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.summary: San Francisco prohibits landlords from selling or using algorithmic devices (software that uses algorithms to analyze nonpublic competitor rental data) to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Legislation adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024.
rules.penalty: allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law
